title: Dynamical Evidence for a Billion Solar-mass Black Hole in Galaxy NGC 4061 from ALMA <SUP>12</SUP>CO(2─1) Kinematics
question: What is the dynamical mass of the supermassive black hole in the massive early-type galaxy NGC 4061, and does it resolve the discrepancy between previous indirect estimates based on conflicting velocity dispersion measurements?

data.sensitivity: CO cube: 0.4 mJy beam^-1 per 10 km s^-1; continuum: 120 uJy beam^-1 (text) or 0.02 mJy per beam (Table 1)

what.value: Distance D = 107.2 Mpc, effective radius Re ~ 4.2-9.1 kpc, and K-band absolute magnitude M_K = -25.3 mag

evidence.quote: NGC 4061 is a massive early-type galaxy (ETG) at a distance of $D = 107.2$ Mpc, with an effective radius estimated in the range $R_e \sim 4.2$–$9.1$ kpc and a $K$-band absolute magnitude of $M_K=-25.3$ mag (cite: Ma14).

what.value: Central stellar velocity dispersion sigma ~ 290 km s^-1

evidence.quote: However, (cite: Pinkney2005) reported a much lower central dispersion of $\sigma\approx290$ km s$^{-1}$, based on stellar kinematics derived long slit on the LDSS-3 instrument at the Magellan Clay telescope

what.value: Stellar/ionized-gas velocity dispersion sigma ~ 459 km s^-1

evidence.quote: The Hypercat catalog lists an exceptionally large stellar velocity dispersion of $\sigma\approx459$ km s$^{-1}$, implying an extremely massive BH ($M_{\rm BH} \approx 1.2\times10^{10}$ M$_{\odot}$) from the (cite: Kormendy13) relation.

what.value: Redshift z ~ 0.024450 and distance range 68-112 Mpc

evidence.quote: For NGC 4061 ($z \approx 0.024450$; NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database), we adopted a luminosity distance of $D_L = 107.2$ Mpc (cite: Ma14)
Since the inferred $M_{\rm BH}$ scales linearly with the assumed distance ($M_{\rm BH} \propto D$), the wide range of distance estimates for NGC 4061 (68–112 Mpc; NED)

recipe.goal: Calibrate, combine, and image 1.3 mm continuum and 12CO(2-1) line cube
recipe.method: Calibrate Cycle 6 and Cycle 7 execution blocks with the ALMA Science Pipeline, combine the three measurement sets with CASA concat using visweightscale, image the 1.3 mm continuum with tclean (MFS) and fit source with imfit, subtract continuum in the uv plane with uvcontsub, and image the 12CO(2-1) cube with tclean (Högbom deconvolver)
key_parameters: visweightscale = 0.6 (2019.1.00036.S) and 0.2 for each of the two 2018.1.00397.S tracks
Briggs robust = 0.5, pixel scale = 0.04'', image size = 512 x 512 pixels^2, channel width = 10 km s^-1, clean threshold = 1.5 sigma_RMS

recipe.goal: Create moment maps, extract integrated spectrum and PVDs, and derive molecular gas mass and ISM MGE model
recipe.method: Generate moment 0, 1, and 2 maps using the masked-moment technique (spatial Gaussian smoothing with sigma = 1.5 x theta_FWHM and Hanning spectral smoothing of 4 channels on a copy of the cube to build a mask), compute total molecular gas mass from integrated CO flux, and fit an MGE model to the molecular gas mass surface density map
key_parameters: Mask threshold = 0.5 sigma_RMS in unsmoothed cube (8 sigma_RMS in smoothed cube); integrated spectrum aperture = 6'' x 6''; PVD pseudo-slit width = 2 pixels (0.158'') along PA ~ 175 deg
assumptions: X_CO = 2 x 10^20 cm^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1, D_L = 107.2 Mpc, z = 0.024450, 12CO(2-1)/12CO(1-0) flux density ratio = 1, dust mass neglected

recipe.goal: Construct 3D stellar light and mass MGE model from HST/WFPC2 imaging
recipe.method: Subtract sky background from HST/WFPC2 F814W and F555W images, generate TINYTIM PSFs and combine/resample with AstroDrizzle, mask dust lane and point sources using SExtractor, decompose PSF with mge_fit_sectors, and fit deconvolved galaxy light MGE with mge_fit_sectors_regularized
key_parameters: PSF resampled pixel scale = 0.1''; F814W zero point = 24.204 mag, M_sun,I = 4.52 mag (AB); F555W zero point = 24.683 mag, M_sun,V = 4.82 mag
assumptions: Axisymmetric 3D light distribution, spatially constant mass-to-light ratio (in fiducial model), dark matter neglected in the central region

recipe.goal: Fit 3D ALMA 12CO(2-1) data cube kinematics with KinMS and MCMC to measure SMBH mass and M/L
recipe.method: Forward-model the 3D CO data cube using KinMS with circular velocities computed via JamPy mge_vcirc from the combined SMBH + stellar MGE + ISM MGE potential, using both SkySampler CLEAN-component clouds and an analytic Gaussian disk profile, and fit via Bayesian MCMC using AdaMet
key_parameters: 9 free parameters: log(M_BH), M/L_F814W, f, i, Gamma, sigma_gas, x_c, y_c, v_off; 10^6 SkySampler particles; Gaussian disk mu = 0.09'', sigma = 0.79''; N = 78,100 constraints; noise rescaling factor (2N)^0.25 ~ 20
assumptions: Circular orbits in a razor-thin disk (scale height d = 0''), constant intrinsic velocity dispersion sigma_gas, distance D = 107.2 Mpc

recipe.goal: Fit molecular-gas-only SMBH scaling relations (M_BH-sigma and M_BH-M_K,bulge)
recipe.method: Compile 35 molecular-gas-based SMBH mass measurements (1 CARMA + 34 ALMA including NGC 4061) and perform linear regression in log-linear space using SciPy linregress
assumptions: Log-linear scaling relations with flat priors on fitting parameters

score_reason: The paper provides complete ALMA track IDs, CASA versions, concat weights, imaging parameters, explicit MGE tables for the ISM, PSF, and fiducial F814W stellar model, and full MCMC priors and posteriors. Minor deductions for unstated line-free channel ranges, an unexplained mention of self-calibration, and missing dust-mask coordinates.
rediscovery_reason: Both ALMA datasets (2018.1.00397.S and 2019.1.00036.S) and the HST WFPC2 data (PID 9106) are public, the MGE tables and KinMS/AdaMet modeling parameters are explicitly tabulated, and the primary goal is a clear numeric measurement of M_BH and M/L_F814W.
